mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reference_line ( approval_id, referencer_id, referencer_name, reference_rank ) VALUES ( #{approvalId}, #{referencerId}, #{referencerName}, #{referenceRank} )
mapper.select: SELECT referencer_id AS referencerId, referencer_name AS referencerName, reference_rank AS referenceRank, read_dt AS readDate FROM reference_line WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} ORDER BY reference_id ASC
